evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Before I proceed on asking you questions about the move, do you have any other concerns aside from the pricing?
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: So for this move normally for a two bedroom apartment, we finished the move-in five and a half hours. evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: So would you like to be on the schedule for October 10th? No deposit is required. [Customer immediately responds without pause; rep does not hold silence]
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: So would you like to be on the schedule for October 10th? No deposit is required. [Built-in soft out: 'Maybe, sure no worries I'll just send you an email... just reply to that email if you're ready to book with us.']
evidence_quotes.booking_partial: Confirmed date (October 10th), addresses (pickup 18111 Conterra Apt 1415, delivery 238 Saint Francis Ave), and details about the move content. Missing: phone number, arrival window, crew size explicitly confirmed.

top_strength: Jeline gathered exceptional logistics detail — property types, floor counts, walking distances, garage contents, access concerns (steps, surface type), TV size, and adjusted the estimate down when the customer clarified she'd already moved one bedroom out, showing real attentiveness to what affects pricing.
coaching_note: Section 5 (Two Promises) and Section 6 (final concerns check) were completely skipped; when the customer asked to think it over and email back, Jeline should have delivered the On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage promises first, then genuinely asked what was still concerning her before accepting the defer, rather than abandoning those sections entirely.
